page.overview:
Who is Lightning's Lightning Returns: Final Fantasy XIII battle quotes?

Lightning is the sole directly-controllable player character in Lightning Returns: Final Fantasy XIII. She utters various lines during battle, depending on actions taken.

I'll release your soul. Right, if this is what you want. No time for hesitation. You disgust me. No room for doubts now. Could be a problem. Better be careful. Good, a challenge. —Requires Equilibrium, Vengeance, Vigilance, Innocence, Ultimatus, Divergence, or Providence to be the field garb.

I won't turn back now. I'll see you...in the new world. —Requires Dark Muse, Helter Skelter, Electronica, Witching Hour, Candy Raver, Woodland Walker, or Sand Fox to be the field garb.

The world will be safer without you. Even the wicked have souls. —Requires L'ange Noir, Cyber Jumpsuit, Passion Rouge, L'automne, Martial Monk, Duelist, or Black Mage to be the field garb.
